name: AM Identity and LINE Connection Registry
type: Platform identity and LINE routing contract
requiresDatabases: PostgreSQL tenant-scoped identity tables with forced RLS

dataIsolation.guard: External identities are namespaced by provider and connection, raw LINE user IDs are hashed/encrypted project-locally, and every runtime request must resolve an active tenant membership before capability use.

definitionOfDone: Identity and LINE contract is installed project-locally with all new features defaulting off
Additive schema and forced RLS deny missing tenant context and cross-tenant reads/writes
Six-digit binding challenges are hashed, short-lived, single-use, rate-limited and audited
Private LINE routing uses active workspace; group LINE routing uses group binding
Legacy compare mode can run without changing existing production behavior
Rollback leaves identity/audit rows intact and switches authority back to legacy or compare
